title: Quiltor version history v1
description: A world's local version history. GET /api/history?world=ID lists the versions; POST /api/history/restore?world=ID takes { id } and puts that version back after keeping the current state as "Before restore" (T-87 B). An unknown id answers 404 backup.snapshot_not_found, a missing or damaged blob 409 backup_content_integrity; in both cases the world documents are unchanged.

subject.description: The persisted name, as written. The client words automatic and before-restore names itself.

kind.description: Who named the version (contracts/persistence/history-labels). manual: typed by the author. automatic: named by the server, nothing but the database changed. changes: named by the server after chapters or profiles changed. before-restore, cloud-sync, before-cloud-sync, cloud-sync-conflict: written by those operations. The client words every kind but manual itself.

changes.description: Only for kind changes: the titles of the chapters and profiles the version changed against its parent. Absent when the parent is not in this history.

warnings.description: The restore committed, but the readable mirror files could not be rewritten.
